label: Record of life and climate
text: EA.O.A3.5 Record of life and climate. Occurrence of organisms in strata is owned here; their biology is BI.O.A4.5. Mass extinctions are pattern claims about that record. Paleoclimate and paleoceanography as dated states, read from proxies, are owned here. Their mechanism cites EA.O.A4.3. The Anthropocene as a formal unit was rejected by the IUGS in March 2024 (stratigraphy.org/news/152).

warrant.standard: Stratigraphic context; correlation by two independent methods
